findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored and used.
findings.comment: Observed a bottle of Multi surface cleaner to be on the same shelving unit as dry foods. Discussed with PIC, education was provided on proper chemical storage and cleaner was moved to an approved location.
findings.citation_text: 7-301.11 Separation. POISONOUS or TOXIC MATERIALS shall be stored and displayed for retail sale so they can not contaminate FOOD, EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS, LINENS, and SINGLESERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES by: (A) Separating the POISONOUS or TOXIC MATERIALS by spacing or partitioning; and (B) Locating the POISONOUS OR TOXIC MATERIALS in an area that is not above FOOD, EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS, LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE or SINGLE-USE ARTICLES.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
Observed multiple instances where hand washing opportunities were missed. Staff was observed handling personal phone and hair without handwashing after, and before donning gloves. Discussed with PIC, ensure staff is hand washing at a frequency that prevents contamination. 

2-301.14: FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including (A)-(I) any activities that may have contaminated the hands.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.comment:
Observed the concentration of the sanitizer bottle, Buckeye Eco Disinfectant, to be at 2600 ppm. The sanitizing concentration should be 660 ppm. Discussed with PIC, ensure sanitizer bottles are made at the correct concentration level. The chemical in question is an approved sanitizer with instructions, but the product should be diluted. Discussed with Director and the sanitizer bottle will be labeled properly for the kitchen so there is a distinction between the disinfection bottles of the kids rooms and the kitchen. 

7-204.11: (A)-(B): Chemical SANITIZERS applied for FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall meet regulatory requirements.

findings.title: Personal cleanliness
findings.comment:
Observed operator to have sleeveless shirt. Discussed with PIC, ensure food handling staff is wearing shirt with minimum cap sleeve. 

2-304.11: Food employees shall wear outer clothing to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service and single-use articles.

findings.title: In-use utensils: properly stored
findings.comment:
Observed multiple containers of silverware to be sitting handle facing down. Discussed with PIC and inverted. Ensure utensil's are stored handle side up to prevent contamination and to avoid the portion going into the mouth being touched by hand. 

3-304.12: FOOD preparation and dispensing UTENSILS shall be stored: (A) in FOOD with their handles above top of FOOD and container

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the top of the dish machine to have an accumulation of food debris. Discussed with PIC, ensure non food contact surfaces are cleaned at a frequency that prevents food accumulation. 

4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.
